Installs and loads the core packages of the 'ggsegverse', an ecosystem
for plotting brain atlases and mapping data onto brain regions in 2D and
3D, together with 'ggplot2', in a single call. Also provides helpers to
find and install atlas packages, report package versions, and detect
namespace conflicts. Learn more about the 'ggsegverse' ecosystem at
\<<https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggseg/>\>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ggseg_atlas_repos()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/ggseg_atlas_repos.md)
  : List available ggseg atlas packages
- [`ggsegverse_conflicts()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/ggsegverse_conflicts.md)
  : Conflicts between ggsegverse packages and other loaded packages
- [`ggsegverse_deps()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/ggsegverse_deps.md)
  : List ggsegverse package dependencies and versions
- [`ggsegverse_packages()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/ggsegverse_packages.md)
  : List the core ggsegverse packages
- [`ggsegverse_sitrep()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/ggsegverse_sitrep.md)
  : Situation report for ggsegverse
- [`ggsegverse_update()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/ggsegverse_update.md)
  : Update ggsegverse packages
- [`install_ggseg_atlas()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/install_ggseg_atlas.md)
  : Install a ggseg atlas package
- [`install_ggseg_atlas_all()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/install_ggseg_atlas_all.md)
  : Install all available ggseg atlas packages
- [`installed_ggseg_atlases()`](https://ggseg.github.io/ggsegverse/reference/installed_ggseg_atlases.md)
  : List installed ggseg atlas packages
